title: Part 1: Knowledge Ingestion & Multi-Connector Verification
description: Validates enterprise multi-format connector ingestion (17 formats), incremental sync, deletion propagation, corrupted file handling, and multi-tenant isolation.

assertions.name: Multi_Format_Enterprise_Connector_Coverage
assertions.message: Knowledge ingestion pipeline connects to all 17 enterprise formats (PDF, Git, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Salesforce).

assertions.name: Incremental_Sync_And_Deletion_Propagation
assertions.message: Incremental sync updated modified versions and purged deleted assets across knowledge indexes.

assertions.name: Corrupted_Payload_Fault_Tolerance_Isolation
assertions.message: Corrupted ingestion file isolated without interrupting the multi-file ingestion pipeline.

assertions.name: MultiTenant_Ingestion_Boundary_Isolation
assertions.message: Multi-tenant context tagging isolated asset ingestion across tenant boundary spaces.
